records.title: Alex Rivera — Biography
records.content: Alex Rivera is a backend engineer based in Lisbon, Portugal, with five years of experience building APIs, data pipelines and developer tools.

records.title: Education
records.content: Alex Rivera holds a BSc in Computer Science from the University of Lisbon and an AWS Certified Developer – Associate certification.

records.title: Senior Backend Engineer at Northwind (2022 – Present)
records.content: At Northwind, Alex Rivera leads the payments API team, migrated a monolith to FastAPI microservices, and cut p95 checkout latency from 900 ms to 180 ms.

records.title: Python, FastAPI & PostgreSQL
records.content: Alex Rivera works daily with Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL and Redis, and deploys services with Docker and GitHub Actions.

records.title: Tidewatch — Open-Source Uptime Monitor
records.content: Tidewatch is an open-source uptime monitor built by Alex Rivera with FastAPI and HTMX. It checks HTTP endpoints every minute and sends alerts to Slack and email.

records.title: Ledgerly — Personal Budgeting App
records.content: Ledgerly is a personal budgeting web app by Alex Rivera with a React frontend and a Python API that categorises bank transactions automatically.

records.title: Designing Idempotent APIs
records.content: In the article "Designing Idempotent APIs", Alex Rivera explains how idempotency keys prevent duplicate payments when clients retry requests.

records.title: GitHub — @alex-rivera-dev
records.content: Alex Rivera's GitHub profile is https://github.com/alex-rivera-dev, home to Tidewatch and Ledgerly.

records.title: How can I contact Alex Rivera?
records.content: You can contact Alex Rivera by email at alex@example.com or through the contact form on https://example.com.

records.title: Is Alex Rivera open to new roles?
records.content: Alex Rivera is open to senior backend and platform engineering roles, remote or in Lisbon.
